ep0_street_palmers_closed.say: PALMER'S. Closed until there's a reason.

ep0_street_cafe_closed.say: After. I need to lie down in a specific way.

then.caption:
TWENTY MINUTES OF
LIGHT RAIL LATER

else.say: The train is here. The reason to take it isn't.

onWin.say: The hum stops. The sign stays. The sign always stays.

then.say: It keeps humming. It has all day. It has every day.

ep0_street_scooters.say: Three rental scooters. Nobody is riding them. They are doing fifteen in the snow.

ep0_street_goose.say: HONK. It is not a greeting.

ep0_street_analyst.say: Khakis. Lanyard. Clipboard. It is already writing you down.

ep0_street_analyst_duo.say: Two of them. They are comparing notes. The notes are you.

npc_street_shoveler.say: I've shoveled this square four times today. The city calls it a job. I call it a relationship.

npc_street_cyclist.say: It's not cold if you're angry enough.

npc_street_busker.say: I take requests. I can't play them. But I take them.

npc_street_crust_punk.say: Her name's Also Bajonka. No relation.

npc_street_also_bajonka.say: Also Bajonka sniffs your hand, considers it, and declines.

then.say: No clipboard. No relation. She has never made anyone sign anything.

npc_street_office_worker.say: Did you see the sky? {var:billboardsTagged} billboards went down. My boss cried.

npc_street_stranger.say: Whoa, man. The stars are heavy tonight.

npc_street_smoker.say: They're on in ten. The drummer looks… wet.

then.say:
CEDAR PAWN & LOAN. BACK IN 10.
The sign has said 10 for a week.

else.say: Cedar Pawn. I buy anything that isn't Vanguard. They track it.

then.say: A pedalboard that smells like oat milk? …Eleven dollars.

npc_street_pawn_window.say: Under a tarp: a tin-can robot. NOT FOR SALE (YET).

npc_street_towers_sign.say: RENT DUE. ALSO: RENT INCREASE. ALSO: RENT.

then.say: My brain thinks they're repeating themselves. My brain thinks it's working.

npc_street_shelter_ad.say:
WORK IS LOVE.
{color:gray}LOVE IS A VANGUARD TRADEMARK.{/color}

then.say: My dad signed off on that trademark. He got a plaque. The plaque says WORK IS LOVE.

npc_street_pizza_box.say: A Pizza Luce box, left by the bench. Still warm? No. Nothing in Minneapolis is still warm.

else.say: One slice was in there. It isn't now. You know where it went.

then.say:
A new flyer on the hydrant.
LOST: MOHAWK. SENTIMENTAL VALUE. NO QUESTIONS.

else.say:
A flyer taped to the hydrant.
LOST: CAT. ANSWERS TO 'NO.'

npc_street_bike_rack.say: Three U-locks. Zero bikes. The locks are winning.

npc_street_van.say: A van. No plates. Somebody spray-painted a spiral on the side and nobody on this street owns a van.

then.say: My brain thinks it's been here longer than I have.

npc_street_tree.say: A bare tree. It is doing its best. Its best is February.
